expected_findings.quote: Page 1: Automated fetal cardiac function evaluation in pregnancy affected by congenital heart disease / Page 3: Automated Fetal Cardiac Function Parameters in Congenital Heart Diseases
expected_findings.note: The title on the cover differs from the title in the study synopsis.

expected_findings.quote: Protocol Title: Automated fetal cardiac function evaluation in pregnancy affected by congenital heart disease Version Number: 5 Date of Protocol: 30 September 2022 HREC Reference: 2022/ETH00943
expected_findings.note: The protocol does not include the NCT05698277 registration identifier.

expected_findings.quote: Each study site will perform the same procedures as internationally published literature (34-57) to ensure uniformity
expected_findings.note: Sites are expected to follow published procedures, but the protocol does not fully describe standardization, equipment calibration, or inter-observer assessment.

expected_findings.quote: Page 9: De-identification will be undertaken at image acquisition by the RHW doctors prior to image review by the engineers / Page 13: Patient privacy will be protected by deidentifying data once initial data abstraction has occurred
expected_findings.note: Two passages refer to de-identification at image acquisition and after initial data abstraction; it is unclear how the timing applies to each data type.

expected_findings.quote: Ultrasound images will be saved locally in the ultrasound machine by the same assigned patient’s study number and uploaded to a specific onedrive folder created in Sydney
expected_findings.note: Ultrasound images are uploaded to a Sydney OneDrive folder; permissions, cross-site access, and download/transfer controls are not described in detail.

expected_findings.quote: Fetal cardiac volumes and 2D images with inadequate quality due to fetal movements, presence of acoustic shadows of fetal ribs or spine, and maternal breathing will be excluded
expected_findings.note: Images of inadequate quality are excluded, but explicit, uniform image-quality acceptance criteria are not detailed.

expected_findings.quote: Page 10: Patients’ information will be collected anonymously / Page 13: Identified data will only be accessible to Professor Welsh and Dr Erenbourg.
expected_findings.note: The text describes data as collected anonymously but elsewhere identifies access to identifiable data; the terminology and sequence of de-identification need clarification.
Cardiovascular profile scoring ranges may overlap at an HA/CA value of 0.35, creating ambiguity in scoring.

expected_findings.quote: Page 8: They will be approached by a member of the research team (Dr Erenbourg) and not by their treating doctor / Page 12: Each participating centre will have a site researcher, a fetal cardiologist who will discuss and sign consent form, collect ultrasound images and relevant patients’ data
expected_findings.note: The recruitment paragraph names Dr Erenbourg, while the responsibilities paragraph assigns consent discussions and signatures to local site researchers; site-specific roles should be clarified.

expected_findings.quote: Page 6: More specifically the aim is to estimate whether there is a significant difference in each parameter between fetuses with CHD overall compared to healthy fetuses and then by subgroups of different CHDs / Page 12: Secondary outcomes comparing cases and controls at a single time point will be analysed in a similar way to the primary outcome, subject to checks of assumptions
expected_findings.note: Multiple cardiac-function parameters and disease subgroups are compared, but the handling of multiple statistical comparisons is not described.
